#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <climits>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

class Node {
public:
    vector<struct Edge*> edges;
    int index; // index in nodes vector
    Node() { }
};

class Edge {
public:
    bool forward; // true: edge is in original graph
    Node* from;
    Node* to;
    long long flow;
    const long long capacity;
    Edge* dual;
    long long cost; // used for MinCost
    Edge(Node* s, Node* d, long long c, bool f) : from(s), to(d), capacity(c), flow(0), forward(f), cost(0) { }
    long long remaining() { return capacity - flow; }
    void addFlow(long long amount) {
        flow += amount;
        dual->flow -= amount;
    }
};

class MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    vector<Node*> nodes;

    MaxFlowSolver(int n=0) {
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) addNode();
    }

    virtual ~MaxFlowSolver() {
        for (auto n : nodes) delete n;
    }

    Node* addNode() {
        Node* n = new Node();
        n->index = (int)nodes.size();
        nodes.push_back(n);
        return n;
    }

    void link(Node* n1, Node* n2, long long capacity) {
        link(n1, n2, capacity, 1);
    }

    void link(Node* n1, Node* n2, long long capacity, long long cost) {
        Edge* e12 = new Edge(n1, n2, capacity, true);
        Edge* e21 = new Edge(n2, n1, 0, false);
        e12->dual = e21;
        e21->dual = e12;
        n1->edges.push_back(e12);
        n2->edges.push_back(e21);
        e12->cost = cost;
        e21->cost = -cost;
    }

    virtual long long getMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) = 0;
};

class MinCostMaxFlowSolver : public MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    MinCostMaxFlowSolver() : MaxFlowSolver() { }
    MinCostMaxFlowSolver(int n) : MaxFlowSolver(n) { }

    virtual long long* getMinCostMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) = 0;
    virtual ~MinCostMaxFlowSolver() { }
};

class EdmondsKarp : public MinCostMaxFlowSolver {
public:
    long long minCost;

    EdmondsKarp() : MinCostMaxFlowSolver() { minCost=0; }
    EdmondsKarp(int n) : MinCostMaxFlowSolver(n) { minCost=0; }

    long long* getMinCostMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) override {
        long long maxflow = getMaxFlow(src, snk);
        long long* result = new long long[2]{maxflow, minCost};
        return result;
    }

    const long long INF = LLONG_MAX/4;

    long long getMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) override {
        int n = (int)nodes.size();
        int source = src->index;
        int sink = snk->index;
        long long flow = 0;
        long long cost = 0;
        vector<long long> potential(n,0);
        while (true) {
            vector<Edge*> parent(n,nullptr);
            vector<long long> dist(n,INF);
            dist[source]=0;
            priority_queue<pair<long long,int>, vector<pair<long long,int>>, greater<pair<long long,int>>> que;
            que.push({0,source});
            while(!que.empty()) {
                auto [d,v]=que.top(); que.pop();
                if (d!=dist[v]) continue;
                for (auto e : nodes[v]->edges) {
                    long long temp = dist[v]+e->cost+potential[v]-potential[e->to->index];
                    if (e->capacity > e->flow && dist[e->to->index]>temp) {
                        dist[e->to->index]=temp;
                        parent[e->to->index]=e;
                        que.push({temp,e->to->index});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[sink]==nullptr) break;
            for (int i=0;i<n;i++) {
                if (parent[i]!=nullptr) {
                    potential[i]+=dist[i];
                }
            }
            long long augFlow=LLONG_MAX;
            for (int i=sink; i!=source; i=parent[i]->from->index) {
                augFlow=min(augFlow, parent[i]->capacity - parent[i]->flow);
            }
            for (int i=sink; i!=source; i=parent[i]->from->index) {
                Edge* e=parent[i];
                e->addFlow(augFlow);
                cost+=augFlow*e->cost;
            }
            flow+=augFlow;
        }
        minCost=cost;
        return flow;
    }
};

struct FastScanner {
    istream& in;
    string buffer;
    stringstream ss;

    FastScanner(istream& in_stream): in(in_stream) {}

    string next() {
        while (!(ss >> buffer)) {
            if (!(in>>buffer))
                return "";
            ss.clear();
            ss.str(buffer);
        }
        string res;
        in>>res;
        return res;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int res; in>>res; return res;
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        long long res; in>>res; return res;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    FastScanner scanner(cin);
    int N = scanner.nextInt();
    int M = scanner.nextInt();
    int K = scanner.nextInt();
    int C = scanner.nextInt();
    int D = scanner.nextInt();

    EdmondsKarp solver;

    vector<int> people(K);
    for(int i=0; i<K; i++) {
        people[i]=scanner.nextInt()-1;
    }

    Node* src=solver.addNode();
    Node* snk=solver.addNode();

    const int amt=150;
    vector<vector<Node*>> timeNodes(N, vector<Node*>(amt));
    for(int i=0; i<N; i++) {
        for(int j=1; j<amt; j++) {
            timeNodes[i][j]=solver.addNode();
            if(j>1) {
                solver.link(timeNodes[i][j-1], timeNodes[i][j], LLONG_MAX, 0);
            }
        }
    }
    for(int i=0; i<K; i++) {
        solver.link(src, timeNodes[people[i]][1], 1, 0);
    }
    for(int i=1; i<amt; i++) {
        for(int j=0; j<K; j++) {
            solver.link(timeNodes[0][i], snk, 1, C*i - C);
        }
    }
    for(int i=0; i<M; i++) {
        int a= scanner.nextInt()-1;
        int b= scanner.nextInt()-1;
        for(int j=1; j<amt-1; j++) {
            int prev=0;
            for(int k=1; k<=K; k++) {
                long long cost_val= D*k*k - prev;
                solver.link(timeNodes[a][j], timeNodes[b][j+1], 1, cost_val);
                solver.link(timeNodes[b][j], timeNodes[a][j+1], 1, cost_val);
                prev= D*k*k;
            }
        }
    }
    auto ret=solver.getMinCostMaxFlow(src,snk);
    cout<<ret[1]<<endl;
    delete[] ret;
    return 0;
}
